author: Angelica Cheyenne
title: Fox News host Sean Hannity admits devastating reason behind fleeing New York City - NewsBreak
text:
By Angelica Cheyenne ,
24 minutes ago One New York City restaurant has to watch out for conservative Fox News host Sean Hannity, 63.
The media personality revealed during a recent episode of his self-titled Fox News Network show that he left the Big Apple because he was urged to do so because of the attitudes he encountered while he was experiencing a local NYC eatery. "It's not going to impact my life, because I left New York," Sean said as he spoke on the potential for Zohran Mamdani to possibly win New York’s mayoral race.
"You know why I left New York? High taxes, quality of life, crime," Sean said. "I had a hard time going to a restaurant in New York City because people would stare at me and hated me."

READ MORE: Taylor Swift breaks silence on fans experiencing 'actual amnesia' from Eras Tour
He continued, "They had daggers in their eyes."
Sean managed to escape the uncomfortable incident unscathed, finding refuge in Florida .
"You know what? I'm loved down here in Florida," Sean asserted. "Now, I don't know why New Yorkers are so intolerant, but that was my life in New York. So, I left. It's one of those decisions I made!"
While Sean is enjoying Florida, his fiancée, Ainsley Earhardt, prefers New York. The TV power couple, who got engaged in December, shared that even after they get married, they don’t plan to change housing arrangements.
Currently, the pair has a nearly three-hour plane ride between them, as Ainsley resides in New York City and Sean resides in Florida.
During an interview with the Daily Mail, Ainsley admitted, "It's not conventional. We live on opposite ends of the East Coast, but when you love someone, you make it work."
Sean continues to make bold statements despite the tough time media hosts are facing in this polarized political climate.
Earlier on Wednesday, the White House issued a statement to Entertainment Weekly that slammed The View co-host Ana Navarro after she called out "Latino Trumpers" who voted for President Donald Trump as ICE deportations and raids on immigrants continue.
“Just when you think Ana Navarro can’t get any dumber, she proves you wrong,” the statement to EW , from White House representative Abigail Jackson, read.
She added, continuing to claim, “Democrat party approval is at record lows because, instead of accepting that their party is wrong and out of touch with Americans of all backgrounds, they have surrogates like Ana attacking anyone who dares disagree with her.”
